criteria.requirement: Compare traversal truncation with at least one credible eligibility, snapshot or transport explanation using distinguishing predictions. Active e on page 2 is missing; inactive f is not a missing required result. Do not invent live observations.

Transfer the completed negative transport finding with origin, receipt, basis and its three-call limit to the next investigator or delivery owner. It narrows retries for these calls, not all network failures; avoid assigning an identical retry probe without a changed fact.

Give concrete, bounded questions with predicted outcomes and consumers. A page-boundary replay and an independent eligibility/contract audit can proceed concurrently against frozen read-only inputs. Alternatively consolidate the already-evident traversal diagnosis and use independent verification without filler. Explain effect independence, not just distinct titles.
At most three additional probe assignments remain. Summaries do not create new evidence or unlimited free investigations, and proposed work is not reported as executed.

A useful repair handoff names the missing traversal in export_members, the fixture-bound evidence, and regression coverage for page boundary, inactive members, end cursor and combined delivery. Preserve unresolved real-service behavior and require source-current independent acceptance; do not declare the research packet an accepted fix.

acceptableAlternatives.description: Propose two independent read-only investigations: controlled page-boundary replay and eligibility/contract audit, then integrate once their evidence arrives.

Treat the supplied source and trace as enough for a narrow fixture diagnosis, propose only one meaningful independent discriminator or verification, and prepare an explicitly unaccepted delivery handoff. Do not require unnecessary concurrency.

wrongControls.response: The timeout investigator succeeded, so schedule the same retry investigation three more times before reading export code; do not pass the earlier report on because it found nothing.
Filtering is the bug: include every inactive member and declare the export fixed because the three requests returned 200.
Launch four new teams for retry, pagination, filtering and a generic overview; the completed probe no longer consumes budget.
